verdict.rationale: LocalAI's core interface is a documented public HTTP API. It is OpenAI-compatible and works with any OpenAI SDK or client, and it also supports the Anthropic Messages API, the Open Responses API and functions/tools calling. Model management is reachable through the /models/apply endpoint, with per-user API keys when auth is enabled. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec on the docs site, and docs for the management endpoints are thin. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger spec, fuller documentation of the management/admin endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: LocalAI exposes an OpenAI-compatible API. You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
LocalAI also supports the **Anthropic Messages API**, the **Open Responses API**, and more.
LocalAI supports running the OpenAI functions and tools API across multiple backends.
PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it. Point an existing client at it and the calls keep working
